item.title: [IGNITE-16753] ControlUtility and Zookeeper tests don't run due to updated curator-test dep
item.description:
Commit [1]updated curator-test dependency and now it fetches junit5 dependency. But Ignite runs tests only for junit4. Then we should exclude junit from curator-test to run tests again.

 

It affects control-utility and zookeeper modules.

 

 [1]https://github.com/apache/ignite/commit/fe95954c5072534b52c62a6f643f3cb96f92628b
item.summary: ControlUtility and Zookeeper tests don't run due to updated curator-test dep

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment:
By TC results, the testsuites "Control Utility" and "Control Utility (Zookeeper)" are OK. But "Zookeeper Discovery (1)" failed. 

Due to missing tests on master branch for month there is no comparison with master branch (tests history is too short). Then I compared it with ignite-2.12 branch, and it shows that the testsuite is still broken [1]. I cherry-picked this patch to the ignite-2.12 branch and run it on TC and found that all tests passed [2]. Then it means that zookeeper tests was broken by another commit.
